title: LQA subject manifest
description: Declares a subject as an LQA subject: the instrument under review, the print it is pinned at, and who runs it. Lives at the subject root as lqa.json.

jurisdiction.description: the jurisdiction folder name; its reference set is at ../_jurisdiction

document.description: id of the instrument in registers/source-bundle.json

print.description: the print findings are checked against; updated at 10A when the print changes

stage.description: for a Bill: its stage in each House

legal_drafter.description: the intended recipient at 12H, once known
